card.name: Verbs just before a route of administration
card.fires_on: Verbs like given, administered, or either that come right before the route of delivery, such as orally, intravenously, or by infusion. Seen after a drug name or dose in dosing and animal-study sentences.

modes.label: Given/administered before route
modes.description: The verb given or administered follows a drug or dose and the route comes next.
modes.example: Eptifibatide was not lethal to rats, rabbits, or monkeys when<< administered>> by continuous intravenous infusion for 9

modes.label: Either before oral or IV
modes.description: The word either comes before a choice of routes.

card.writes: It pushes route words such as intravenous, oral, intr-, sub- and trans- to come next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a sentence is about to say how a drug is given, such as by mouth or into a vein.
